name: store-studio
description: Manage App Store Connect and Google Play from Claude Code: upload, reorder and download screenshots for every locale and device, edit store text, upload builds (.ipa on a Mac, .aab anywhere) with staged rollouts, and reach every other endpoint of both official APIs (versions, review submissions, phased releases, pricing, reviews, analytics and sales reports, tracks, Data safety) through reference lookup, reads and confirmed writes. Works with several App Store Connect teams and Play accounts at once, using your own API keys and service accounts; keys never leave your machine.

asc_key_id.title: App Store Connect key ID
asc_key_id.description: Key ID of an App Store Connect team API key (Users and Access > Integrations). Optional: you can leave all options empty and ask Claude to add accounts with account_add.

asc_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: Issuer ID shown above the team keys list. Optional: you can leave all options empty and ask Claude to add accounts with account_add.

asc_private_key.title: App Store Connect private key (.p8)
asc_private_key.description: Path to the AuthKey_XXXX.p8 file you downloaded. Keep it outside any repository. Optional: you can leave all options empty and ask Claude to add accounts with account_add.

play_service_account.title: Google Play service account key (.json)
play_service_account.description: Path to the JSON key of a Google Cloud service account that has access to your app in Play Console. Keep it outside any repository. Optional: you can leave all options empty and ask Claude to add accounts with account_add.

accounts_file.title: More accounts (optional)
accounts_file.description: Path to a JSON file listing extra App Store Connect and Google Play accounts by name, for apps in other teams. Holds key IDs and key file paths only. Defaults to ~/.config/store-studio/accounts.json when that file exists.
